item.title: HR&CE Executive Officer was rightly dismissed from service for failing to protect temple land: Madras High Court
item.description: Justice Krishnaswamy Govindarajan also invokes the parens patriae jurisdiction and calls for details regarding steps taken by Tamil Nadu government to retrieve the land

item.title: Kochi synagogue arson accused linked to two earlier fire incidents: Police
item.description: The Special Investigation Team suspects that videos of the incident were sent to his handlers through Telegram.

item.title: Tamil Nadu government orders additional 25 days of guaranteed employment for vulnerable rural households
item.description: The ‘Vetri 150’ scheme, sanctioned with ₹100 crore for 2026-27, extends VB-G RAM G’s guaranteed employment to 150 days for women-headed, SC/ST and other vulnerable households

item.title: RSS’ Mohan Bhagwat warns against agitations that divide, urges unity rooted in ‘Hindu spirit’
item.description: Citing the recent tension in France and past instances in Nepal and Bangladesh, Mr. Bhagwat alleged that powerful forces were attempting to deepen social divisions and weaken India, as well as its expanded global influence
